description.fun: Regigigas is the giant behind the giants: it shaped Regirock, Regice and Registeel in its own image, and Regieleki and Regidrago too. Legend says it once towed whole continents into place with ropes, much like the Kunibiki myth of Japan, in which a god pulls land across the sea. It sleeps in Snowpoint Temple and rampages if woken, but it calms down for those it befriends.
description.guide: Regigigas is a Normal-type Legendary Pokémon, the creator and leader of the legendary giants Regirock, Regice, Registeel, Regieleki and Regidrago. Legends say it pulled landmasses together with ropes. It sleeps in Snowpoint Temple in Sinnoh.
description.tagline: The colossal golem-maker said to have towed the continents.
